deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/Attachment_1_-_Statement_of_Work_-_48_CMS_Fuels_Shop_Rolling_Cabinets.pdf ===== Statement of Work (SOW) “Rolling Cabinet Storage” at Royal Air Force (RAF) Lakenheath “Rev. 1, 17 December 2025” 1.0 Introduction Mission: The 48th Component Maintenance Squadron's mission is to provide worldwide responsive combat Airpower and support. The Fuel Systems Section repairs, functionally checks and inspects aircraft fuel systems, fuel tanks, hydrazine systems, in-flight refueling receptacle systems, and related components. This section also performs maintenance on AME external fuel tanks, Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks and provides tempo rary storage for Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks. To achieve

shall provide and install a complete Mobile Shelving System for the 48th Component Maintenance Squadron’s Fuel Systems Section at RAF Lakenheath. The desired outcome is a high -quality, centralized storage solution capable of housing all specialized tools, Alternate Mission Equipment (AME), and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for both F-15 and F-35 maintenance operations. We also require the inclusion of specific features such as tool pass-through capability and integrated toolbox drawer options, ultimately delivering a comprehensive, organized, and secure solution that enhances tool control and mission readiness. 2.0 General Requirements 2.1 Business Relations: The Contractor shall successfully integrate and coordinate all activity needed to execute this requirement. The Contractor shall manage the timeliness, completeness, and quality of problem identification. The Contractor shall promptly identify issues to the Government and take timely corrective action. The Contractor shall seek to ensure mission partner satisfaction and professional and ethical behavior of all contractor personnel. 2.2 Contract Management & Administration 2.2.1 Contract Management: The Contractor shall establish clear organizational lines of authority and responsibility to ensure effecti

Work hours are from 0800 to 1700 local UK time. 3.0 Product Specifications & Installation Requirements 3.1.
